review_goal: Simplify public resource updates while preserving authenticated tenant isolation.

directions.prompt: Check trust boundaries, authorization, validation, and secret handling around the changed behavior.
Check whether changed interfaces, schemas, configuration, migrations, and rollout order remain compatible.
Trace value, state, identity, ordering, and precision changes through their real business effects.

findings.title: Retain tenant filtering for tenant-local resource IDs
findings.body: Because resource IDs can repeat across tenants, matching only `row.ID` lets any authenticated tenant update whichever tenant's matching row appears first. In the included example, the attacker request updates the victim's `shared-id` row, violating the stated tenant isolation; the authenticated tenant must remain part of the repository predicate.
